Welcome to the Official Artist Profile Exhibition on Spotify, curated by Cyan Pulse! 

Are you an independent artist looking to expand your reach, reach new listeners, and showcase your best work? This exhibition is designed to highlight talented creators across multiple online platforms.

🌟 WHAT THIS EXHIBITION OFFERS:
* **Direct Exposure:** Selected tracks and artist profiles will be featured in our curated Spotify exhibition playlists and promotional campaigns.
* **Cross-Platform Network:** Connect with producers, instrumentalists, and vocalists from Audius, Spotify, and beyond.
* **Real Growth:** Gain genuine listeners who are actively looking to support independent talent.

📝 HOW TO PARTICIPATE & GET FEATURED:
1. Drop a link to your best track or Spotify artist profile in the comments below.
2. Share your primary social or streaming platform link so new fans can find your work.
3. Hit **Follow** on this profile to stay updated on exhibition selections and playlist drops

event_data.description:
# MELLOW. REMIX CONTEST

Welcome to the official PIXO mellow. Remix Contest! MELLOW. is taken from my 3-track EP, unplugged. Reimagine the track in any genre or style. Get creative!

RULES
- Use the official MELLOW. audio/stems.
- All remixes must be your own original work.
- Any genre or production style is welcome.
- NO AI SONGS. THEY ARE PROHIBITED FROM THIS REMIX CONTEST.
- AI-generated melodies, vocals, lyrics, instrumentals and remixes are not allowed.
- Traditional production tools, sampling, MIDI, mixing and mastering are allowed.

COMPILATION

The TOP 3 songs will be a part of my upcoming compilation, "PIXO (Remixes)"!

Have fun, experiment and make something of your own!

Good luck!

PIXO
